name: Aleksandr Krasnov
biography: Aleksandr has been an industry expert in DevSecOps, has worked in companies like Dropbox, Palo Alto Networks, and Meta/Facebook. He has spent his time doing security research and holds several patents in the area of application security. In the free time, Aleksandr spends time exploring the great outdoors in British Columbia, climbing new boulders, or free diving in the ocean.
